project: How To Play:                                                           1). Within Each level you must find and collect all the keys in each level                                                               2). After Collecting all they keys within the current level, you must find the chest and break/unlock it                                    3). After breaking/unlocking the chest you will be able to kill the all the guards in that level if you lightly touch them(including the boss in the last level)                                             4). You must kill all the guards in the current level to be able to break the gate(The gray wall) so you can go to the next level                                      5). You will have to repeat this cycle until you reach final level where you have the save the princess from the Knight King
